title: Sorting the Catch

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: The fishing boats are in! Their nets have fish, crabs, and plenty of shells.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Fish in the basket, crabs in the crab pot, and the shells go back to the sea.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Sort the catch: fish, crabs, and shells.
steps.hint: Fish have fins. Crabs have claws. Shells are empty homes.

feedback.mismatch: Look again: fins, claws, or an empty shell?

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: The sea is full of God's creatures. We take care to catch only what we need.

journal_line: At the harbour, I sorted the fishing boats' catch with Captain Mara.
unavailable_text: The catch is sorted for today.
